<helmet>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body { margin: 0; background: rgb(247,246,243); color: rgb(17,17,17); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
    a { color: rgb(17,17,17); text-decoration: none; }
    a:hover { color: rgb(97,85,245); }
    ::selection { background: rgba(97,85,245,0.18); }
    @keyframes blurUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); filter: blur(12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: blur(0); } }
    @keyframes aura { 0% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0deg) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(180deg) scale(1.08); } 100% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg) scale(1); } }
    @keyframes drift { 0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) rotate(-14deg); } 50% { transform: translate(60px,-30px) rotate(-8deg); } }
    @keyframes marquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
    @keyframes prog { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } }
    @keyframes orbit { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes orbitRev { to { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }
    @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
    @keyframes shimmer { from { background-position: 0% 50%; } to { background-position: 200% 50%; } }
    @keyframes floaty { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-8px); } }
    @keyframes pulse { 0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: .5; } 100% { transform: scale(1.9); opacity: 0; } }
    [data-hw] { animation: blurUp 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; }
    [data-aura] { animation: aura 48s linear infinite; }
    [data-leak] { animation: drift 16s ease-in-out infinite; }
    [data-mq] { animation: marquee 44s linear infinite; }
    [data-mqwrap]:hover [data-mq] { animation-play-state: paused; }
    [data-float] { animation: floaty 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
    [data-ring] { animation: orbit 90s linear infinite; }
    [data-ring] [data-upright] { animation: orbitRev 90s linear infinite; }
    [data-ring="b"], [data-ring="b"] [data-upright] { animation-direction: reverse; }
    [data-pulse] { animation: pulse 2.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.4,1) infinite; }
    [data-shimmer] { background-size: 200% 100%; animation: shimmer 3s linear infinite; }
    [data-caret] { animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
    .cs-dropdown { position: relative; }
    .cs-menu { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(6px); transition: opacity .25s ease, transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), visibility .25s; }
    .cs-dropdown:hover .cs-menu { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: none; }
    .cs-chev { transition: transform .25s ease; }
    .cs-dropdown:hover .cs-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); }
    [data-bar] { transition: background .4s ease, box-shadow .4s ease; }
    html[data-scrolled] [data-bar] { background: rgba(247,246,243,0.78); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(17,17,17,0.08); }
    html[data-js] [data-rv] { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(32px); filter: blur(10px); transition: opacity 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), filter 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
    html[data-js] [data-rv][data-in] { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
    [data-tab] { transition: background .3s ease, color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, opacity .3s ease; }
    [data-tab][data-on] { background: rgb(255,255,255); color: rgb(17,17,17) !important; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }
    [data-tab] [data-prog] { transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; }
    [data-tab][data-on] [data-prog] { animation: prog 6s linear forwards; }
    [data-vtab] { opacity: .45; }
    [data-vtab][data-on] { opacity: 1; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
    [data-pane] { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.015); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .7s ease, transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
    [data-pane][data-on] { opacity: 1; transform: none; pointer-events: auto; }
    [data-pan] { transition: background-position .8s ease; }
    [data-pane][data-on] [data-pan] { background-position: center bottom !important; transition: background-position 5.4s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) .5s; }
    [data-wc] [data-wimg] { transition: transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .9s ease; }
    [data-wc]:hover [data-wimg] { transform: translateY(-16px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 50px 80px -30px rgba(30,30,60,0.4); }
    [data-wc] [data-wpan] { transition: background-position 3.6s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1); }
    [data-wc]:hover [data-wpan] { background-position: center 100%; }
    [data-wc] [data-go] { transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .3s ease, color .3s ease; }
    [data-wc]:hover [data-go] { transform: rotate(-45deg); background: rgb(17,17,17); color: rgb(255,255,255); }
    [data-spot] { transition: left 1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), top 1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), width 1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), height 1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), box-shadow .8s ease; }
    [data-spot-label] { transition: opacity .4s ease; }
    [data-trow] { max-height: 96px; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity .35s ease, padding .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), margin .5s ease; }
    [data-trow][data-hide] { max-height: 0; opacity: 0; padding-top: 0 !important; padding-bottom: 0 !important; }
    [data-sq][data-empty]::before { content: 'Search'; color: rgb(120,120,128); }
    [data-lever] [data-track] { background: rgb(220,222,228); transition: background .35s ease; }
    [data-lever] [data-knob] { transform: translateX(0); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1); }
    [data-lever][data-on] [data-track] { background: rgb(12,102,228); }
    [data-lever][data-on] [data-knob] { transform: translateX(14px); }
    [data-lever] [data-state]::after { content: 'Off'; }
    [data-lever][data-on] [data-state]::after { content: 'On'; color: rgb(12,102,228); }
    [data-lteam] { transition: background .3s ease, color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease; }
    [data-lteam][data-on] { background: rgb(17,17,17); color: rgb(255,255,255) !important; }
    [data-loop] [data-chip] { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.6) translateY(4px); transition: opacity .35s ease, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }
    [data-loop][data-play] [data-chip] { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    [data-loop] [data-tnode] { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-10px); transition: opacity .5s ease, transform .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
    [data-loop][data-play] [data-tnode] { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    [data-loop] [data-elbow] { transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: top center; transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); transition-delay: inherit; }
    [data-loop][data-play] [data-elbow] { transform: none; }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      [data-g] { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) !important; }
      [data-wc] { grid-column: 1 / -1 !important; height: 500px !important; }
      [data-h1] { font-size: 52px !important; }
      [data-h2] { font-size: 36px !important; }
      [data-quote] { font-size: 30px !important; }
      [data-hide-sm] { display: none !important; }
      [data-orbit] { zoom: .56; }
      [data-reel] { height: 340px !important; }
      [data-sec] { padding-top: 80px !important; padding-bottom: 80px !important; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
      html[data-js] [data-rv] { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
    }
  </style>
  <script src="./gate.js"></script>
</helmet>

<script type="text/x-dc" data-dc-script>
class Component extends DCLogic {
  componentDidMount() {
    var h = document.documentElement; h.setAttribute('data-js', '');
    var q = function (s, r) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((r || document).querySelectorAll(s)); };
    var clamp = function (v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)); };
    var countUp = function (el) {
      var to = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to')), dec = +(el.getAttribute('data-dec') || 0), pre = el.getAttribute('data-pre') || '', suf = el.getAttribute('data-suf') || '';
      var t0 = performance.now();
      var step = function (t) { var p = clamp((t - t0) / 1600); var e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3); el.textContent = pre + (to * e).toFixed(dec) + suf; if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step); };
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    this.tick = function () {
      var vh = window.innerHeight;
      if (window.scrollY > 12) h.setAttribute('data-scrolled', ''); else h.removeAttribute('data-scrolled');
      q('[data-rv]:not([data-in])').forEach(function (el) {
        var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (r.top < vh * 0.9 && r.bottom > 0) { el.setAttribute('data-in', ''); q('[data-count]', el).forEach(countUp); }
      });
      q('[data-loop]:not([data-play])').forEach(function (el) {
        var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (r.top < vh * 0.8 && r.bottom > 0) el.setAttribute('data-play', '');
      });
      q('[data-quote]').forEach(function (qq) {
        var r = qq.getBoundingClientRect();
        var p = clamp((vh * 0.82 - r.top) / (r.height + vh * 0.3));
        var ws = q('[data-w]', qq), n = ws.length;
        ws.forEach(function (w, i) { w.style.opacity = (0.16 + 0.84 * clamp(p * n * 1.2 - i)).toFixed(3); });
      });
    };
    var self = this;
    this.onScroll = function () { if (!self.raf) self.raf = requestAnimationFrame(function () { self.raf = 0; self.tick(); }); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', this.onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', this.onScroll);
    this.boot = setInterval(this.tick, 400);
    this.bootStop = setTimeout(function () { clearInterval(self.boot); }, 4000);
    requestAnimationFrame(this.tick);

    this.setTab = function (g, i) {
      q('[data-tab]', g).forEach(function (t) { t.removeAttribute('data-on'); });
      void g.offsetWidth;
      q('[data-tab]', g).forEach(function (t) { if (+t.getAttribute('data-tab') === i) t.setAttribute('data-on', ''); });
      q('[data-pane]', g).forEach(function (p) { if (+p.getAttribute('data-pane') === i) p.setAttribute('data-on', ''); else p.removeAttribute('data-on'); });
      g._i = i; g._t = Date.now();
    };
    this.tabT = setInterval(function () {
      q('[data-tabs]').forEach(function (g) {
        if (!g._init) { g._init = 1; self.setTab(g, 0); return; }
        var r = g.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (r.bottom < 0 || r.top > window.innerHeight) { g._t = Date.now() - (Date.now() - g._t); return; }
        if (Date.now() - g._t >= 6000) { var n = q('[data-pane]', g).length; self.setTab(g, ((g._i || 0) + 1) % n); }
      });
    }, 150);
    this.onClick = function (e) {
      var t = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-tab]');
      if (!t) return;
      var g = t.closest('[data-tabs]'); if (!g) return;
      e.preventDefault(); self.setTab(g, +t.getAttribute('data-tab'));
    };
    document.addEventListener('click', this.onClick);

    var spots = [
      { l: 0, t: 0, w: 100, h: 100, label: '' },
      { l: 21.1, t: 32.9, w: 52, h: 18.4, label: 'About the team' },
      { l: 21.1, t: 53.2, w: 51.8, h: 46.2, label: 'Members' },
      { l: 77, t: 32.3, w: 21.4, h: 31.6, label: 'Team links' },
      { l: 77, t: 65.8, w: 21.4, h: 17.1, label: 'Details' }
    ];
    this.si = 0;
    this.spotT = setInterval(function () {
      var s = document.querySelector('[data-spot]'); if (!s) return;
      self.si = (self.si + 1) % spots.length; var p = spots[self.si];
      s.style.left = p.l + '%'; s.style.top = p.t + '%'; s.style.width = p.w + '%'; s.style.height = p.h + '%';
      s.style.boxShadow = p.label ? '0 0 0 9999px rgba(16,16,24,0.42), 0 0 0 2px rgb(97,85,245), 0 0 30px 4px rgba(97,85,245,0.35)' : '0 0 0 9999px rgba(16,16,24,0), 0 0 0 2px rgba(97,85,245,0), 0 0 30px 4px rgba(97,85,245,0)';
      var lb = s.querySelector('[data-spot-label]'); if (lb) { if (p.label) lb.textContent = p.label; lb.style.opacity = p.label ? '1' : '0'; }
    }, 2800);

    var queries = ['Marketing', 'Customer', 'Creative'];
    this.S = { q: 0, txt: '', ph: 'rest', n: 0 };
    this.searchT = setInterval(function () {
      var inp = document.querySelector('[data-sq]'); if (!inp) return;
      var S = self.S, target = queries[S.q];
      if (S.ph === 'type') { if (S.txt.length < target.length) S.txt = target.slice(0, S.txt.length + 1); else { S.ph = 'hold'; S.n = 0; } }
      else if (S.ph === 'hold') { if (++S.n > 24) S.ph = 'del'; }
      else if (S.ph === 'del') { if (S.txt.length) S.txt = S.txt.slice(0, -1); else { S.ph = 'rest'; S.n = 0; S.q = (S.q + 1) % queries.length; } }
      else if (S.ph === 'rest') { if (++S.n > 16) S.ph = 'type'; }
      inp.textContent = S.txt;
      if (S.txt) inp.removeAttribute('data-empty'); else inp.setAttribute('data-empty', '');
      var n = 0;
      q('[data-trow]').forEach(function (r) {
        var hit = !S.txt || r.getAttribute('data-trow').toLowerCase().indexOf(S.txt.toLowerCase()) > -1;
        if (hit) { r.removeAttribute('data-hide'); n++; } else r.setAttribute('data-hide', '');
      });
      var c = document.querySelector('[data-tcount]'); if (c) c.textContent = S.txt ? (n + (n === 1 ? ' result' : ' results')) : '68 teams';
    }, 95);

    this.lt = 0;
    this.applyLevers = function () {
      var box = document.querySelector('[data-levers]'); if (!box) return;
      q('[data-lteam]', box).forEach(function (c) { if (+c.getAttribute('data-lteam') === self.lt) c.setAttribute('data-on', ''); else c.removeAttribute('data-on'); });
      q('[data-lever]', box).forEach(function (r, i) {
        var on = ((i * 5 + self.lt * 3 + (i % 3) * self.lt) % 7) < 4;
        setTimeout(function () { if (on) r.setAttribute('data-on', ''); else r.removeAttribute('data-on'); }, i * 70);
      });
    };
    this.leverT = setInterval(function () { self.lt = (self.lt + 1) % 4; self.applyLevers(); }, 3000);
    setTimeout(this.applyLevers, 300);

    this.loopT = setInterval(function () {
      q('[data-loop][data-play]').forEach(function (el) {
        var r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.bottom < 0 || r.top > window.innerHeight) return;
        el.removeAttribute('data-play'); setTimeout(function () { el.setAttribute('data-play', ''); }, 700);
      });
    }, 9000);
  }
  componentWillUnmount() {
    window.removeEventListener('scroll', this.onScroll);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.onScroll);
    document.removeEventListener('click', this.onClick);
    [this.boot, this.tabT, this.spotT, this.searchT, this.leverT, this.loopT].forEach(clearInterval);
    clearTimeout(this.bootStop);
  }
}
</script>
</body>
